supersession_reason: The pre-ingestion review found that v0.1 referred to a supplied matrix-symmetry tolerance without requiring one. v0.2 makes the numerical tolerance explicit before any real-system record is ingested. No physical result was available or used.
purpose: Define the minimum provenance and carrier data required to ingest a real mechanical parent/child system without selecting favorable modes or retroactively filling missing evidence.
shared_coordinate_map_definition: List of objects with parent_coordinate_id and child_coordinate_id. Every parent coordinate must be mapped exactly once to a unique child coordinate by physical identity before target carrier inspection. If the physical calculations do not share a complete comparable parent coordinate set, construct or justify the comparable object upstream rather than optimizing a subset here.
hard_refusals: matrix asymmetry outside the declared software/numerical tolerance
unit mismatch between parent and child without an explicit conversion upstream
incomplete or duplicate parent coordinate mapping
duplicate child coordinates in the shared mapping
mapping not frozen before target carrier inspection
target kinetics used to choose mapping
